title: Register bound on a configuration
statement: Let $m$ and $B$ be natural numbers, let $\Lambda$ be a type, and let $a$ be a configuration with $m$ registers and labels in $\Lambda$. Say that $a$ satisfies the register bound $B$ if every register contains a natural number at most $B$.
